newsitem.title: UK: UK enjoys low inflation, healthy growth - Clarke.
newsitem.headline: UK enjoys low inflation, healthy growth - Clarke.

text.p: The UK enjoys healthy growth, low inflation and a good trade position, Chancellor of the Exchequer Kenneth Clarke said after release of Q3 GDP data. "The UK is well on course to growth faster than France and Germany for the fourth successive year," Clarke said in a statement.
UK Q3 GDP UP 0.8% QQ, +2.3% YY, EX-OIL/GAS +0.8% QQ,+2.3% YY
ONS SAYS Q3 PRODUCTION OUTPUT UP SLIGHTLY DUE TO HIGHER MANUFACTURING OUTPUT
UK AUG GLOBAL TRADE DEFICIT 584 MLN STG, EX-OIL ERRATICS 1.183 BLN STG
